# Crosschain Swap — Swap Assets Across Chains Reference

> Move value across blockchains in one flow by combining a bridge and swaps — for example ETH on Ethereum to USDC on Arbitrum — with route aggregators comparing paths.

## Key Facts
- A cross-chain swap = bridge (carries value between chains) + swaps on one or both sides, in one flow
- Different from a same-chain swap: spans two chains, needs a bridge step, pays gas on both chains
- Route aggregators compare paths across bridges and DEXs, estimating output, fees, gas and time
- Costs: source-chain gas + bridge fee + DEX pool fees + price impact/slippage + destination-chain gas
- You need the native gas token on both chains involved
- Non-custodial: your wallet signs; adds smart-contract, bridge and relayer risk
